items.label: Fits the Whole Family
items.value: These shoe storage boxes fit shoes up to Men's 11 / Women's 12, plus all the kids' shoes. One shoe organizer solution for everyone

items.label: Modular Shoe Wall
items.value: Create your own custom shoe display. Clear plastic stackable shoe boxes let you build a modular storage wall that's as unique as your style

items.label: Complete Dust & Pet Hair Protection
items.value: Keep your floors spotless and every pair safe from dust, dirt, and pet hair. Way better than shoe racks, more ventilated and breathable than shoe cabinets

items.label: Built to Last
items.value: Crafted from premium, thicker ABS material with a reinforced frame. Each box holds over 10 KG (22 lbs) without bending or breaking—ideal for stacking high in your closet organizer system

items.label: Versatile Storage Solution
items.value: More than just shoe boxes. Use them as toy storage organizer bins for clothes, toys, socks, accessories—anywhere, any room in the house
